scientific_question: In the supplied double-fin reconstructed pressure field, consider all mesh cells whose P/Pinf values are finite at every vertex. Investigate the location and intensity of high reconstructed P/Pinf regions. Choose and explain an appropriate analysis procedure. Report the volume-weighted centroid coordinates, and the volume-weighted mean value in the selected region.

case_context.physical_setting: the supplied double-fin reconstructed pressure field Stored coordinates and field scales are used without assigning undeclared SI units. P/Pinf is reconstructed and includes large outliers; no automatic clipping or shock identification is applied.
